title: JDR Ninja VTT Overlay
description:
Streams your table's actual Foundry dice rolls onto a transparent OBS overlay hosted by JDR Ninja, so viewers see the very dice your players rolled, replayed (never re-rolled) with an optional Dice So Nice color pass-through.

Free to install and pair. You can link this module to a JDR Ninja account and run the built-in diagnostics and connection tests at no cost. Relaying real Foundry rolls to the OBS overlay requires a paid JDR Ninja plan. Without a paid plan, pairing and diagnostics still work, but live roll relay is declined and a client-only visual demo remains available on the JDR Ninja VTT Overlay settings page.

Every setting is per-browser (client scope): each table member pairs their own browser to their own JDR Ninja account and streams the table's public rolls to their own overlay. Hidden rolls (GM, blind, self / whispered) are never sent. Works with or without Dice So Nice. System-agnostic: any roll that reaches chat is captured.

suggests.reason: Optional. When present, the overlay dispatches in sync with Dice So Nice and can approximate the roller's dice colors, material and font (cosmetic only).
